name: Starter full-flow: loot, injury, time, actor mention
description: Runs a realistic multi-system turn. Starter version checks for crashes and broad state creation; later versions add exact ownership/time/actor assertions.

steps.text: I search the dead guard, take his rusted iron key, bandage my wounded arm, and hurry toward the old chapel before sunset.
The player stands near a fallen guard on the road to the old chapel.
You find a rusted iron key in the guard's pouch. Your arm still aches, but the bandage slows the bleeding. The road to the chapel takes thirty minutes. Mira follows, clearly uneasy.

whyItMatters: The whole engine must survive realistic turns where several systems may need to work together.
patchHint: If this fails, inspect the first subsystem named in the state diff and runtime error.
